description: Requests a governed agent action. Returns a run ID and policy decision; a terminal receipt is sealed, while HMAC signing, TEE binding, settlement, and provider-verified anchors are reported only when the corresponding evidence is produced.

intent.description: Human-readable description of what the agent intends to do, e.g. 'Send invoice follow-up email to client ABC'.

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters such as recipient address, amount, endpoint URL, or payload body.

spend_cap_override.description: Optional per-call spend cap in USD. Must be less than or equal to the agent's configured policy cap.

webhook_url.description: Optional https:// URL. When the run reaches a terminal state, the gateway POSTs the signed receipt to this URL with X-YAX-Signature: hmac-sha256=<hex>. Eliminates polling.

name: yax_run_secure_workflow

anchored_at.description: Legacy seal timestamp. Consult proof.provider_verification.checkedAt for actual anchor readback time.

policy.description: ShadeGuard policy result including decision, version, and guard status.

proof.description: Conditional Filecoin/BTFS upload references plus provider GET readback/content-match state. A CID alone is not Anchor Verified.

receipt_signature.description: HMAC-SHA-256 signature when a signing key was configured; otherwise an unsigned SHA-256 digest marker.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run, e.g. run_7f29c91a.

status.description: Run status: completed, denied, or pending_approval.

tee_attestation.description: Conditional TEE evidence reference; null unless the executed path produced it. Verify measurement, pin, and receipt binding separately.
